svg.title: Scoring, 0 to 100 across seven weighted dimensions: role relevance 30, candidate fit 20, experience fit 15, location fit 10, company quality 10, recency 10, application quality 5. Verdicts: 85 and above is high priority, 70 to 84 is a good match, below 70 is do not apply. Role relevance carries the most weight because a perfect company with the wrong role is still the wrong job. Weights live in the candidate profile YAML, so they can be changed without code.

section.h2: Seven dimensions. Role relevance weighs the most.

div.div: Application quality: 5Official routes such as Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby and company career pages score higher.
Experience fit: 15Tuned for fresher, entry level and early career postings.
All in one YAMLWeights, roles, locations and thresholds live in the profile file. No code changes.
